senses.gloss: the son of Jacob, progenitor of the tribe of Levi.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:10">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>, a. e. <he>עמד ל׳ וכ׳</he> Levi arose and brought her (the Shekhinah) down &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:36">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: שבט ל׳, or ל׳ the tribe of Levi; בן ל׳ or ל׳ a Levite.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 26a:6">Yoma 26ᵃ</cite> <he>דאתי משבט ל׳</he> a descendant of the tribe of Levi.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 3:8">Hor. III, 8</cite> <he>כהן קודם לל׳ ל׳ וכ׳</he> a priest goes before a Levite (in religious privileges), a Levite before an Israelite.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 8:5">Ib. VIII, 5</cite> <he>בת ל׳</he> if she is the daughter of a Levite.

senses.gloss: name of several Amoraim, esp. Levi, or L. bar Sisi, disciple of R. Jehudah han-Nasi (v. Fr. M’bo, p. 110ᵇ).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:6:6">Y. Yeb. XII, 13ᵃ</cite> top.
